subject.title: fix(discord): disable ws 8.21.0 receiver part limits for gateway sockets

question: Should OpenClaw disable `ws` retained-part receiver limits for trusted Discord gateway sockets, or require finite Discord-specific caps before merge?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically focused, but it deliberately removes dependency security hardening on a network socket, so the permanent resource-exhaustion posture needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Discord-only exemption
options.body: Merge the focused fix if maintainers agree Discord gateway traffic is trusted enough to restore pre-8.21 behavior only on these sockets.

options.title: Require finite Discord caps
options.body: Ask for high bounded `maxBufferedChunks` and `maxFragments` values if maintainers want to preserve a retained-part resource guard.

options.title: Pause for fuller product-path proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a full OpenClaw Discord plugin run demonstrates after-fix stability through product wiring.

recommendation.title: Accept Discord-only exemption
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix if maintainers agree Discord gateway traffic is trusted enough to restore pre-8.21 behavior only on these sockets.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned on the PR and has the strongest recent history on the affected Discord gateway constructor and diagnostic path.
